settings.title: Made and numbered
settings.text: Each pair carries a numbered QR tag under the tongue, with a matching label on the box.

settings.title: Signed and recorded
settings.text: When the pair is finished, its artisan writes a workshop card: the pair's number, the day, and one line about this pair alone.

settings.title: Registered to you
settings.text: Scan the tag, or enter the serial below (e.g. EVX-7F3K9QMD). Your pair's certificate opens with your name and its story.

settings.heading: Every pair, its own chapter
settings.text: Every EvlveX pair is numbered, signed by its artisan and registered to its owner. Scan its QR tag, or enter the serial below, to confirm it is genuine and read its story.
